title: Office 365 MCP Values
description: Values for the Office 365 MCP Helm chart. Python FastMCP server for Microsoft 365. Exposure uses base chart Gateway API routes (no custom Ingress).

mcpConfig.description: Configuration for the Office 365 MCP Server, mapped to environment variables (PUBLIC_BASE_URL, ENTRA_TENANT_ID, ENTRA_CLIENT_ID, TOOLS_PRESET/TOOLS_ENABLED).

publicBaseUrl.description: The externally-reachable OAuth issuer URL that clients are redirected to. Must be https. Example: https://office-365.mcp.unique.app

entra.description: The Entra app registration that users sign in through

tenantId.description: One tenant's ID, or 'organizations' for a multi-tenant registration.

clientId.description: The client ID of the Entra app registration that users sign in through.

clientSecret.description: The app registration's client secret, used for the On-Behalf-Of token exchange.

tools.description: The tool surface this deployment runs; set exactly one of preset or enabled.

preset.description: Which tools this deployment runs, as a named surface such as 'teams'.

enabled.description: Which tools this deployment runs, as a comma-separated list of tool names.

folder.description: Grafana folder name for the dashboard
